thread:
Anna (CS): Quick weekly account check for Brightline — seeing an uptick in error signals over the last 48h. Need triage before renewal review next month. High-level:
- 5xx rate increased from ~0.4% -> ~2.7% (24h)
- Timeouts (client p95 > 2s) tripled vs baseline
- Rate-limit (429) spikes during burst windows

Top failing endpoints by error count (24h):
1) /api/v1/generate  — 4,120 errors (mostly 502)
2) /api/v1/chat/completions — 2,050 timeouts / connection resets
3) /api/v1/embeddings — 1,300 429s
4) /v1/stream — 720 connection resets / timeouts

Quick SLI query we used:
```
select uri, error_type, count(*) as errs
from requests
where project = 'brightline' and (status >= 500 or status = 429 or latency_ms > 2000)
group by uri, error_type
order by errs desc
limit 10
```

Can @Mike (Ops) and @Jess (Runtime) take point on infra/runtime causes? Customer has a big onboarding job running — Rahul, FYI for enablement ask. Thanks :pray:
thread_followup_1: Mike (Ops): I pulled infra traces — there was a deploy at 03:14 UTC that increased queue pressure on gpu-pool-7. Rollback at 03:22 but retries + client-side backoffs caused a second-wave of 502s. I opened INC-4281 and muted the noisy alert for brightline-prod while we stabilize. Partial mitigation: temporarily increased worker replicas and bumped request timeout from 30s -> 45s for the affected service. Link: https://incidents/redwood/INC-4281
thread_followup_2:
Jess (Runtime): Confirming what Mike said. KV cache eviction rate spiked (cache miss x3) which drove more model cold starts. Suggests: 1) increase KV cache TTL for brightline route; 2) cap per-customer concurrency to 4 for /api/v1/generate; 3) enable lightweight batching on the route. I'll open a config PR and can roll to canary first. Snippet for proposed change:
```
routes:
  - match: /api/v1/generate
    limits:
      concurrency: 4
    batching:
      enabled: true
      max_batch_size: 8
```
thread_followup_3: Rahul (SE): Brightline confirmed they shipped a migration that turned many batched calls into many small concurrent requests (200 concurrent small requests). I'll run a 30m enablement session today 16:00 PT to show them batching patterns and client-side retry best-practices. Action: ask them to switch to single-call batching or exponential backoff to avoid hitting 429/502 cascades.
thread_followup_4:
Anna (CS): Action list (TL;DR):
- Mike: incident write-up + infra tweak follow-up (INC-4281) — ETA 2h
- Jess: config PR for concurrency cap + KV TTL + enable batching — will canary and report
- Rahul: enablement call at 16:00 PT, share sample client code to reduce concurrency

Please drop updates in this thread. I'm tracking this in the onboarding tracker (BR-482) — renewal risk flagged as 'watch' until mitigations hold. :eyes:
thread_followup_5: deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout window for runtime config change: 2024-11-01T03:00Z -> 2024-11-01T03:30Z. Canary target: brightline-prod route only. :rocket:
thread_followup_6: Mike (Ops): Update — increased worker replicas held the burst. 5xx rate down to ~0.9% and p95 latency trending toward baseline. Will close INC-4281 after final postmortem. Leaving alert thresholds slightly relaxed for next 24h while canary runs.
thread_followup_7: Anna (CS): Awesome, thanks everyone. I'll follow up with Brightline after Rahul's call and confirm config changes. If metrics stay green by EOD we'll move renewal flag back to low risk. :party_parrot:
